title: Return Fee Amount Clause — Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract
content:
**Return fee.** The return fee on a vehicle returned under the return option of a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract is the return fee for the contract's tier, as listed in the return option schedule, rounded to the cent.

**Assembly.** The basis of the return fee is set first and every reduction that applies is then subtracted from it; the return fee that remains never falls below zero and is rounded to the cent.

## Tier reading

| Contract tier | Return fee |
|---|---|
| Any tier | The tier's return fee from the return option schedule |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical tier figure)

A contract whose tier lists a return fee of USD 400.00 carries a return fee of USD 400.00. Nothing in the clause depends on the mileage driven, the wear assessed or the date within the return window.
